title: Efficient Serving for Dynamic Agent Workflows with Prediction-based KV-Cache Management
authors: Haoyu Zheng; Fangcheng Fu; Jia Wu; Binhang Yuan; Yongqiang Zhang; Hao Wang; Yuanyuan Zhu; Xiao Yan; Jiawei Jiang
affiliations: Wuhan University, Dameng Database, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Macquarie University, HKUST
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction

problem_statement.en: LLM-based agent workflows share substantial context that enables KV-cache reuse, but existing managers either work at agent-level (ignoring workflow reuse) or assume static workflow call graphs. Real workflows are dynamic and runtime-dependent, so KV-cache management must shift from assuming the future to predicting it under inherent prediction error.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 agent workflow 之間共享大量 context，提供 KV cache 重用契機；然而現有管理機制要麼在 agent 層級運作而忽略 workflow 層次的重用，要麼假設 workflow 呼叫圖為靜態。實際 workflow 呈現動態且依賴 runtime 結果，因此 KV cache 管理必須由「假設未來」轉為「在不可避免的預測誤差下預測未來」。

key_innovation.en: PBKV introduces a prediction-based KV-cache management framework with three components: (i) a multi-signal GraphSAGE predictor that fuses graph-level transition patterns with per-request prefill embeddings and forecasts the next K agent invocations; (ii) hierarchical eviction that reclaims retired cache first and then ranks active cache via a K-step lookahead Value(c) score aggregated across workflows; (iii) conservative prefetching restricted to idle GPU space and idle PCIe bandwidth so prefetching never displaces valuable cache. PBKV is proven Lipschitz-continuous in prediction error.
key_innovation.zh: PBKV 提出基於預測的 KV cache 管理框架，包含三個組件：(i) 多訊號 GraphSAGE 預測器，融合全域呼叫圖的轉移模式與請求層級 prefill embedding，輸出未來 K 步 agent invocation 機率；(ii) 階層式 eviction，先回收已終止 workflow 的 retired cache，再以跨 workflow 聚合之 K 步 lookahead Value(c) 分數排序 active cache；(iii) 保守式 prefetching，僅在閒置 GPU 空間與閒置 PCIe 頻寬上執行，確保 prefetch 不會排擠高價值 cache。論文證明 PBKV 對預測誤差具備 Lipschitz 連續的退化保證。

key_improvements.en: On dynamic workflows: up to 1.85x lower workflow latency and up to 2.55x higher KV-Cache hit rate over LRU; on static workflows up to 1.26x latency and 1.39x hit rate over KVFlow. Lifecycle-aware eviction alone gives up to 1.66x hit-rate gain over LRU.
key_improvements.zh: 在動態 workflow 上：相較 LRU，workflow 延遲最高降低 1.85x、KV cache 命中率最高提升 2.55x；在靜態 workflow 上，相較 KVFlow 延遲與命中率分別提升 1.26x 與 1.39x。單獨啟用 lifecycle-aware eviction 即可較 LRU 提升 1.66x 命中率。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
reported_accuracy: 1-step accuracy 0.94, 3-step accuracy 0.77 on HoVer dataset (GraphSAGE backbone, 1K training traces)
validation_workloads: HoVer + LangChain (fact verification), SWE-bench + AutoGen (code generation), FinanceBench + CrewAI (document analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Predictor must be trained on a workload-specific trace set (~1K traces); cache-reuse indicator A_w(c) assumes a basic per-agent access model that may need customization when frameworks specify cache inheritance between agents; conservative prefetching only activates on pure-decode batches (>90% of measurements); per-invocation predictor latency overhead ~1.56 ms is treated as negligible relative to LLM inference.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測器需針對特定 workload 訓練（約 1K 條 trace）；cache 重用指標 A_w(c) 採用基本的 per-agent 存取假設，若 framework 規定 agent 間 cache 繼承關係則需客製化；保守式 prefetching 僅在純 decode batch（量測中 >90%）下啟用；每次 invocation 的預測器額外耗時約 1.56 ms，相較 LLM 推論被視為可忽略。

infra_layer: KV-cache reuse, Serving / scheduling, State fabric / offload

workloads_traces.en: HoVer with LangChain iterative fact verification, SWE-bench with AutoGen retrying code generation, and FinanceBench with a static CrewAI document-analysis workflow.
workloads_traces.zh: HoVer 搭配 LangChain 迭代式事實驗證、SWE-bench 搭配 AutoGen 重試式程式生成，以及 FinanceBench 搭配靜態 CrewAI 文件分析 workflow。

key_parameters.en: 8x A6000 48 GB, TP=2, 20 GB/s measured PCIe; HICACHE_RATIO=1; concurrency HoVer 72, SWE-bench 24, FinanceBench 48; 10 repetitions; predictor trained on 1,000 traces and tested on 500; K=3 (sweep 1-5), gamma=0.7 (sweep 0.5-0.9); concurrency-pressure sweep 36/48/60/72/84/96; conservative prefetch uses only free plus retired space and idle-bandwidth budget; aggressive rho optimum 20%. Prefix lengths, QPS, tool distribution, absolute cache capacity, and TTL not stated.
key_parameters.zh: 8x A6000 48 GB、TP=2、實測 PCIe 20 GB/s；HICACHE_RATIO=1；併發為 HoVer 72、SWE-bench 24、FinanceBench 48；每項設定重複 10 次；predictor 以 1,000 traces 訓練、500 traces 測試；K=3（sweep 1–5）、gamma=0.7（sweep 0.5–0.9）；併發壓力 sweep 為 36/48/60/72/84/96；保守 prefetch 僅使用 free 與 retired space 及 idle-bandwidth budget；aggressive rho 最佳值為 20%。prefix 長度、QPS、工具分布、絕對 cache 容量與 TTL 未載明。

metrics_defined.en: E2E workflow latency is submission to final completion; per-agent TTFT is the mean over every invocation in a workflow; hit rate is average token-level GPU KV-cache hit rate.
metrics_defined.zh: E2E workflow latency 自提交起至最終完成；per-agent TTFT 為 workflow 中所有 invocation 的平均值；hit rate 為平均 token-level GPU KV-cache hit rate。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Up to 1.85x E2E, 2.03x TTFT, and 2.55x hit-rate gains over LRU; on the static Finance workflow, only up to 1.26x latency and 1.39x hit-rate gains over KVFlow, and below concurrency 60 all policies nearly tie.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 相較 LRU，E2E、TTFT 與 hit rate 最高分別提升 1.85x、2.03x 與 2.55x；在靜態 Finance workflow 上，相較 KVFlow 僅達 1.26x latency 與 1.39x hit rate，且併發低於 60 時各政策近乎相同。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: PBKV assumes a workload-specific global call graph and offline transition traces remain representative; abrupt unseen agents or transition drift weaken its K-step predictions.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: PBKV 假設 workload-specific global call graph 與離線 transition traces 仍具代表性；突發的未見 agent 或 transition drift 會削弱其 K-step 預測。
